guardrailRules.name: Monthly FinOps Spend Ceiling
guardrailRules.description: Cloud resources estimated above threshold require approval before calling AWS creation APIs.

guardrailRules.name: Enforce KMS / SSE Encryption at Rest
guardrailRules.description: Blocks creating unencrypted S3, SQS, RDS, or ElastiCache resources and flags unencrypted AWS resources in live scans.

guardrailRules.name: Block Public Access & Privileged Pods
guardrailRules.description: Blocks public RDS/S3 provisioning and blocks `privileged: true` pods during real pipeline manifest scans.

guardrailRules.name: Production Resource Deletion Lock
guardrailRules.description: Prevents deleting production cloud resources until unlocked.

guardrailRules.name: Approved Sovereignty Regions
guardrailRules.description: Flags or blocks deployments outside approved regions (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1).
